name: self-update-and-ci-release
title: Add self-update and GitHub Actions release pipeline
description: Add a root-safe useless update command backed by the self_update crate (GitHub Releases, checksum digest verification, auto service restart) and a tag-driven GitHub Actions pipeline that runs fmt/clippy/tests, builds multi-target Linux release archives with sha256 checksums, and publishes them so the self-updater can consume them.
creator: jdjingdian
